name: RACE
description: RACE (ReAding Comprehension dataset from Examinations) is a large-scale reading comprehension benchmark collected from English exams for Chinese middle and high school students. Each instance consists of a passage, a question, and four answer choices. Covers a wide range of topics and requires various reasoning skills including detail recognition, inference, and main idea understanding.
reputation: Large-scale reading comprehension benchmark from real-world exams; widely used in pre-BERT era and BERT-era research; human performance ~94.5%
notes: Introduced at EMNLP 2017. Split into RACE-M (middle school, ~28K) and RACE-H (high school, ~69K). High school portion is harder due to more complex inference required. Collected from real exam materials. One of the largest reading comprehension datasets of its time. Largely saturated by modern LLMs.
